step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Undeliverable Mail .
Comments: Type “Address search.”

Details: Type the appropriate option:
“[Type of undeliverable mail] initially sent on [date] was received as undeliverable on [date] — unable to reach client to obtain new address.”
“[Type of undeliverable mail] initially sent on [date] was received as undeliverable on [date] — unable to reach client to confirm address obtained from [third-party source].”
Select Save .

step.cmd: Determine if the new address for the client is unconfirmed or unknown.

ul.li: If the new address is unconfirmed, go to step 3.
If the new address is unknown, go to step 4.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the Q-01-00-00 letter. Unless specified, select the most appropriate option for each of the following attributes:

ul.li: Information Requested Re: ROE / RFS / Undeliverable Mail / Additional Info required (2876)
Undeliverable Mail Active/Inactive claim (2878): Select Undeliverable Mail inactive claim .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a skeleton claim:

ul.li: If no, go to step 5.
If yes, go to step 7.

step.cmd: Determine if an active claim is displayed on the Summary screen or a renewable claim is displayed on the Dormant tab:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 6.
If no, go to step 12.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if a D48 or an MA48 is imposed:

ul.li: If no, go to step 7.
If yes, go to step 12.

step.cmd: Determine what type of undeliverable mail was returned:

ul.li: If the undeliverable mail is an A-00-00-11, A-00-00-13, A-00-00-14, P-02-00-00, P-03-00-00 or P-04-00-00, ACS letter, go to step 8.
If the undeliverable mail is another type of ACS letter, go to step 9.
If the undeliverable mail is a T4E, shred it. No further action is required.
If the undeliverable mail is a benefit statement with an access code, go to step 10.
If the undeliverable mail is none of the above, go to step 11.

step.cmd: Send an email to the Incident Management and Legislative Disclosures unit as follows:

ul.li: Subject: Type “Undeliverable privacy letter.”
Body: Enter the client’s name and the file number of the letter returned as undeliverable.
Go to step 9.

step.cmd: In ACS, set the original letter to “undeliverable.” Shred the letter and image the envelope. To image the envelope, refer to Preparing documents for imaging .
Image the unopened envelope containing the benefit statement. To image the envelope, refer to Preparing documents for imaging .
Prepare the undeliverable mail for imaging. Refer to Preparing documents for imaging .
Determine what type of undeliverable mail was returned:

ul.li: If the undeliverable mail is an ACS letter, go to step 13.
If the undeliverable mail is a document that can be obtained from an internal system (e.g. FTS, PSCD, NWS), go to step 14.
If the undeliverable mail is none of the above, go to step 15.

step.cmd: In ACS, indicate that the original letter is “undeliverable.” Shred the letter and image the envelope. To image the envelope, refer to Preparing documents for imaging . No further action is required.
Shred the undeliverable mail. No further action is required.
Write PA on the document and send it for imaging. Refer to Preparing documents for imaging .
